entities.summary: Huang Liang-chi is a Taiwanese tennis player playing on the ATP Challenger Tour. On 11 August 2014, he reached his highest ATP doubles ranking of No. 172 and his highest singles ranking of No. 223 achieved on 13 July 2015.
